# LibSync

> LibSync is an open-source AI assistant for public libraries. It answers library-desk questions (fees, renewals, printing, meeting rooms, finding and citing sources) from a library's own policies and open catalogs, and says so when it cannot check something. Built with PydanticAI, Groq and Pinecone on a $0/month stack. MIT licensed. Nearly all code is written by Claude Code under the author's direction; the author is the architect.

## Project
- [Source code](https://github.com/JohnnieMaeB/LibSync): README, architecture, tier plans
- [Live demo](https://johnniemaeb.github.io/LibSync/): free-tier backend, first message after idle may take about a minute
- [Architecture](https://github.com/JohnnieMaeB/LibSync/blob/main/ARCHITECTURE.md): design decisions and the bugs the unit tests missed
